$comment: INTEGRIQ DRAFT (native-data-gathering-provider, ported from spectr/connectors): Source and Job ship isEnabled false, per the requirement that a connector blocked on an unbuilt capability ships disabled. GAP: CSV parsing. That capability has landed in Integriq through the change mapping-formats-and-lookups (sourceConfig.format 'csv', REQ-MFL-001), but this draft's synchronization is not yet switched to it and its bilingual column mapping has never run live; the per-fiscal-year files run to ~150 MB, which is the open large-file streaming follow-up. Enable only after switching the format and one watched live run. ORIGINAL SPECTR NOTE: Phase-2 wave-2 OpenConnector ingestion config for Canada CanadaBuys (federal procurement open data). concurrentie-analyse/scripts/sync/sync_canada_canadabuys.py downloads per-fiscal-year CSV bulk files (`{FY}-TenderNotice-AvisAppelOffres.csv`, 67 bilingual EN/FR columns, ~153MB full historical / smaller per-FY, daily-updated). Public, unauthenticated (keyless - docstring: 'No authentication required - direct download'). SHIPPED AS A DOCUMENTED DRAFT, Source + Job DISABLED, blocked by the same CSV engine gap as Ireland: openconnector#105 added JSONL + single-file gzip, NOT CSV parsing - fetchSinglePageData() tries gunzip (n/a), json_decode (fails on CSV), simplexml (fails on CSV), silently yielding zero. Second consideration even if CSV were supported: the per-FY files are large (the full historical file is ~153MB); a whole-file in-memory parse would be a real memory risk (cf. estonia_rhr.json's 36MB XML caution). Field paths from the script (bilingual columns): referenceNumber/solicitationNumber (id), tenderDescription (title), contractingEntityName (organisation), publicationDate, tenderClosingDate, unspsc (classification - UNSPSC not CPV), procurementCategory (GD/SRV/CNST -> contract type), procurementMethod (procedure), noticeURL. The mapping below uses those column names so it is a starting point for a future CSV mode; not usable today. Recommended interim path: the existing etl/ CSV loader (etl/bulk_load.sh) for the per-FY files. The script's own UNSPSC 43/8111 + keyword IT filter is a DB-side classification layer over the full CSV, not an API constraint - a connector would ingest the full feed.
